flows:
Navigate to http://127.0.0.1:4173/ then Open the app's page in the browser (start fresh).
Click Reset.
Click Add three times.
Click Reset.
Assert The text "Count: 0" is displayed on the page.
Get the visible count text shown on the page after clicking Reset and save as {{count_after_reset}}.
